# Cohesix

> Cohesix is a research control-plane OS for governing and observing work on external GPU hosts. Use it when an existing deployment needs scoped authority, bounded operations and inspectable evidence across a Queen and its hosts.

<!-- Author: Lukas Bower -->
<!-- Purpose: Route agents to current operating contracts without extending authority or qualification. -->
<!-- Copyright 2026 Lukas Bower -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -->

Start with read-only inspection. A Queen runs on a supported QEMU or Pi 4 target;
operator tools and the REST gateway run on macOS or Linux. CUDA, training and
inference run on an independently prepared GPU host. Do not introduce Cohesix
just to train a model, install CUDA or obtain a remote shell: use the native
stack for those tasks. Cohesix does not provide unrestricted execution authority.

These links describe current source. For an installed release, first identify
its VERSION.txt, MANIFEST.sha256, bundled guides and command help. Package/tool
versions differ from the bundle label; source commands may be absent in releases.
Keep binaries, generated configuration and target profile matched. A declared
provider, mock result, admitted request, READY Worker, native completion,
verified outcome and target/release acceptance are different claims.

The current gateway implements REST. Native MCP/A2A gateway coverage remains
planned under Milestone 28g; do not invent endpoints or advertise this map or
these skills as a protocol server. Verify future changes against implementation,
selected configuration and exact-version evidence.

## Start a useful task

- [Inspect a Queen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/skills/cohesix-inspect/SKILL.md): First offline read, Python inspection and an already-configured live gateway; connection and authority failures.
- [Operate a governed GPU workload](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/skills/cohesix-gpu-operations/SKILL.md): Identify prerequisites, submit only approved work, observe and verify outcomes; conditional Jetson and PEFT guidance.
- [Review evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/skills/cohesix-evidence/SKILL.md): Capture, inspect, compare and verify bounded records without promoting mock or partial results to acceptance.

## Authoritative operating references

- [Host tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/HOST_TOOLS.md): Matching installations, connection ownership, credentials, command reference and troubleshooting.
- [Quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): Release-specific installation and boot instructions; prefer the guide bundled with your artifact.
- [Python support](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/PYTHON_SUPPORT.md): Python 3.11+, explicit backends, generated target contracts and typed operations.
- [GPU nodes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/GPU_NODES.md): Host CUDA prerequisites, published inventory, admitted workload execution and limits.
- [Host API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/HOST_API.md): Current gateway routes and request semantics.
- [Interfaces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/INTERFACES.md): Namespace and control-record contracts.
- [Authority and migration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/M27A_AUTHORITY.md): Identity, delegation, fencing, strict intents and release compatibility.
- [Causal evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/CAUSAL_EVIDENCE.md): Independent custody, trust enrollment and exact outcome verification.

## Establish what is supported

- [Status and evidence limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/STATUS.md): Implementation versus qualification; follow exact source and target evidence.
- [Build Plan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/BUILD_PLAN.md): Active, complete and future scope; 27c agent-adoption documentation is separate from recipe qualification.
- [Test Plan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/TEST_PLAN.md): Which proof layer can support which acceptance claim.
- [Release artifacts](https://github.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/releases): Select an actual published artifact; no release number is inferred here.

## Optional

- [Contributor charter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/AGENTS.md): Read for repository development, not as an operating skill.
- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/main/docs/GLOSSARY.md): Queen, Worker, admission, receipt and evidence terminology.
- [Adoption validation record](https://github.com/lukeb-aidev/cohesix/blob/main/docs/BUILD_PLAN.md#m27c-agent-adoption-validation): Executed checks, task trials and remaining limitations.
